verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's instance overview docs state that instances bill by the second for actual usage, which covers the per-second granularity and the billed-only-for-use core of the story. The evidence is a single brief line in the docs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of what is or isn't charged when an instance is stopped (e.g., storage charges), detailed billing-granularity docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of per-second billing.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running

citations.quote: Bills by the second for actual usage
